verdict.rationale: Porkbun's llms.txt documents an availability and pricing check across hundreds of TLDs that needs no auth, so code can call it directly. Agents can reach it through the official MCP server (96 tools) and the zero-setup /mock mirror of every endpoint. The registration dryRun also runs availability pre-flight checks. Missing for 10: any documented rate limits for the check endpoint, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the check API works as described.
